title: *MGT401 GDB SOLUTION*
text:
*MGT401 GDB SOLUTION*
 𝐕𝐈𝐑𝐓𝐔𝐀𝐋 𝐀𝐋𝐄𝐑𝐓'𝐒 🇵🇰

> 📍Ideal solution don't copy paste

Case 1: No

Alpha Ltd. cannot offset these amounts because there is no legal agreement or intention to settle them together. Therefore, the Rs. 15,000 receivable and Rs. 9,000 payable must be shown separately.

Case 2: Yes

Sunshine Ltd. can report the net amount of Rs. 30,000 because a valid agreement allows offsetting, and the company intends to settle both balances on a net basis.

Case 3: No

SM Ltd. cannot combine these balances because no legal agreement exists among the companies. The Rs. 40,000 receivable and Rs. 25,000 payable must be reported separately.

Case 4: No
